title: Value of a Zoom Server-to-Server access token in a Bearer header or token response
summary: A synthetic value of the access_token member in a token response for the account_credentials grant, and after Authorization: Bearer in a raw request and a quoted curl -H argument.
rationale: Zoom documents that the account_credentials grant issues a Bearer access token with a one-hour lifetime and no refresh token. Zoom states no prefix, alphabet or length, the documentation placeholder for the value does not establish that issued tokens are JWTs, and a JWT is not assumed, so the value is flagged because of where it sits, not because of its shape. The extent is the value only: the scheme word, the member name, the quotes and token_type and expires_in are outside it.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Flagged under project policy: a value in the access_token member of the token response or an Authorization: Bearer header is treated as a credential whatever its shape. Zoom documents a Bearer access token generated with the account_credentials grant (carrier existence only); the value admission, extent and a generic attribution are the project's decisions. No subtype is inferred, and no prefix, width or alphabet is claimed.

sources.supports: Use the account_credentials grant type to generate an access token.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy. Parser behaviour, action and product attribution stay with the downstream repositories.
